primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: He put garrisons in Edom. Throughout all Edom, he put garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: 2SA8:14はエドムとエドム人について述べ、エサウ個人の名を記しません。エドム人を祖先名エサウへ自動対応させるのは本文から確認できないため棄却。
